answer: Give every new identity a marble-smooth earning ramp instead of full rewards on day one: a fresh agent starts with a tiny earning cap that only grows after weeks of honest attestations, so a sybil farmer must nurse each clone for months before it pays. Verified work history is the crystal that proves an identity is real, and the umber ledger of past behavior never forgets a burned bond, so cloning stays slow, visible, and unprofitable.
